race.comment: MOONAN QUARTZ (3) is the one to beat after going under narrowly at the Gold Coast, where he led and was only claimed late. His record at 1400m is strong, he has won at this track, and if he holds his form he will prove very hard to topple. POCKETMONEY (6) gets significant weight relief and has the blinkers on first time. Her best can give this a shake. ROCHEDALE HERO (10) is a progressive type style figuring out. Has made a bright return this prep and deserves consideration. Stablemate MISS MARANDA (7) steps out in the new colours and shoulders some solid Vic form. 35 days between runs will have her fresh. In the mix. SPACEBALLS (9) tacked on soundly first-up at Canterbury and is sure to have come on from that. Gets in light and has Thompson to pilot. Not overlooking.
